_about: Registration of the KEEL adapters in a PROJECT .claude/settings.json (not the global one: global hooks hit every project). Prefer `python tools/install_hooks.py --project <path>`: it writes this with absolute paths and pins the absolute path of the interpreter that ran it. To copy by hand, replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/keel with the folder you cloned and `python` with the absolute path of a Python 3.11+ interpreter if `python` is not on the session's PATH. Use `python`, not `pythonw`, and keep `-S -E`: the layer needs no site packages, and processing them costs tens of ms on every call (measured on one machine). PreToolUse is optional (the installer does not register it, to save one process per call); PostToolUseFailure is what records failed tool calls.
